claims.text: The hotel is at 2401 M St. NW in Washington, D.C.

findings.quote: 2401 M St. NW, Washington, District of Columbia 20037

claims.text: Balance Gym includes an indoor salt water pool, a steam room, sauna and whirlpool.

findings.quote: These features include an indoor salt water pool, a steam room, sauna and whirlpool

claims.text: Pets of all sizes are welcome as long as they are leashed at all times.

findings.quote: Pets of all sizes are welcome at Fairmont Washington, D.C., Georgetown, as long as they are leashed at all times.

claims.text: A limited number of bicycles are available for guests, subject to availability.

findings.quote: We are pleased to provide a limited number of bicycles for use by our guests during their stay.

claims.text: Turn down service is automatic for Signature Suite and Fairmont Gold guests and on request for all other rooms.

findings.quote: Turn down service is provided to our Signauture Suite and Fairmont Gold guest automatically and all other guest rooms upon request.

findings.quote: The hotel unveiled the results of a $27 million renovation in June 2016, offering up a total redo of each of the hotel's 415 guest rooms and suites

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2024 and 2026.
The hotel's dining showcases sustainable produce and authentic culinary talent.

findings.quote: showcases sustainable produce and authentic culinary talent

findings.quote: We are pleased to offer complimentary in-residence membership to Balance Gym-Foggy Bottom for all hotel guests Located on our Mezzanine level

claims.text: Georgie, the Fairmont Canine Ambassador, greets guests at the hotel.

findings.quote: Georgie, Fairmont Canine Ambassador. Georgie joyfully spends her days meeting, greeting and making guests feel welcome.

claims.text: Rooms have eggplant-hued couches, tufted cream-colored headboards and custom-commissioned, politically savvy artwork.

findings.quote: anchored by eggplant-hued couches and tufted, cream-colored headboards, and decked out with custom-commissioned, politically savvy artwork

findings.quote: rent a bike from the front desk (complimentary for President's Club members) and cruise along the river to the nearby Kennedy Center and Lincoln Memorial

findings.quote: Paid valet parking with unlimited in and out privileges is available

findings.quote: Browsing speed wi-fi is available complimentary to ALL - Accor Live Limitless members. Daily internet access fee is $14.95 plus applicable tax for non-members.
